title: docs(spec, plugin-security): the renamedFrom holder carry runs at boot and after each announced reload
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5wpk1gsxYNKAkG5qioWPNY)_ Refs #33301 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none PR 1 of 2 for #33301. This one carries the spec and plugin-security text and lands by the seat. The ADR-0150 D7 addendum sentence is `docs/adr/**` (Tier H) and goes in a separate PR after this one merges; that PR closes the card. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：只改文字。`PositionSchema.renamedFrom` 的说明（jsdoc 与 `.describe()`，及其生成的参考文档）、`liveness/position.json` 中 `renamedFrom` 的证据描述、以及 plugin-security 中职位改名持有人迁移的两处代码注释，改为与 #33245 合入后的实际行为一致：启动时迁移全部声明，运行中每次 `metadata:reloaded` 只迁移通告点名的包或职位。 - **为什么改**：#33245 之后迁移不再只在启动时运行，原文“只在启动时”已不实；评审 6880449445 ④ 指出两处注释对通告条目的描述比代码更窄。 - **风险与回滚**：无行为变化，无 schema、取值或测试改动。回滚即 revert。 - **先看**：`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts`（`renamedFrom` 的说明）、`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`（"When it runs" 一节）。 - **两分钟验证**：`git grep -n "At boot the platform moves" -- packages content`，预期无命中；`content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx` 的 `renamedFrom` 行与新的 describe 一致。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。 ## What changes Each text now says what PR #33245 does on `main` (read from the code, not the card): the carry runs at `kernel:bootstrapped` over every claim, then on each `metadata:reloaded` after the boot run over the claims of what the announcement names as registered, read from its `changed` list (`positionRenameReloadScope`): `app/ID` while the registry holds package `ID`, and `position/NAME` of any grammar-valid name, whichever announcer sends the entry. Carried at once: a hot install-local install, a per-item publish of a position, the positions of a publish-drafts. Carried at the next restart: a hot upgrade over a version the running kernel still serves (its old position still reads as declared), the runtime `POST /packages` install and enable routes (they do not announce), and an artifact reload that names only its file. - **`packages/spec/src/identity/position.zod.ts`**, `PositionSchema.renamedFrom`: - jsdoc: "Read only by the boot carry (… at `kernel:bootstrapped`)" now names both runs and the doors above; "the boot carry judges the same rules again" reads "the holder carry"; "named in the boot log" reads "named in the run's log". - `.describe()`: "At boot the platform moves every holder … a second boot moves nothing" now says holders move at boot and again when a running kernel announces the position or its package as registered (a hot install, a per-item publish, a publish of drafts), names the three cases carried at the next restart, and ends "A second run moves nothing". "listed in the boot log" reads "listed in the log". No tracker number in the runtime string. - **`content/docs/references/identity/position.mdx`**: regenerated by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (`gen:docs`), one row. - **`packages/spec/liveness/position.json`**, `renamedFrom.evidence`: the prose after the `#carryRenamedPositionHolders` pointer names both runs. The pointers are unchanged; `verifiedAt` and `note` are unchanged. - **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/position-renamed-holder-carry.ts`**, "When it runs" (review 6880449445 ④ nits 1 and 2), comments only: - an entry in the `app/ID` or `position/NAME` spelling counts whichever announcer sends it; - `position/NAME` admits any name in the position-name grammar (the claims whose new name is `NAME`), not only "a position the catalog serves now"; - publish-drafts' unhidden `app/NAME` counts when `NAME` is a held package id; - the artifact reload has two payload shapes: the file watcher announces the file path, the dev HMR POST (`POST /api/v1/dev/metadata-events`) announces the `changed` list its caller sent (the file path when it sent none), whose entries in those two spellings count. - **`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-start-hooks.ts`**: the carry's hook comment says the same, and the `metadata:reloaded` handler comment names the per-item publish and publish-drafts beside the hot install. Comments only. - **`.changeset/33301-renamed-from-carry-text.md`**: `@objectstack/spec` patch (the describe ships in `dist`, `json-schema/` and `src/**/*.zod.ts`; `liveness/` is in `files[]`). ## Tests No test, no ablation: no behaviour, schema or test expectation changes. No test pins the old sentences (`git grep` for "At boot the platform moves", "Read only by the boot carry" and "from SecurityPlugin's start hooks" on `origin/main` hit only the three edited files and the generated reference). ## Acceptance notes - **No `@objectstack/plugin-security` changeset (measured).** Its `files[]` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` only. After `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/plugin-security`, `grep -rl` over `packages/plugins/plugin-security/dist` (js, mjs, d.ts, d.mts, maps) finds neither new comment phrase ("whichever announcer sends", "dev HMR POST"); positive control: `carryRenamedPositionHolders` hits `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`. The comment change publishes nothing from that package. - The artifact reload: the card lists it among the doors carried at the next restart. The code agrees for the file watcher, but the dev-only HMR POST forwards its caller's `changed` list, so an HMR POST that names `app/ID` or `position/NAME` is scoped and carried at once. The texts say "an artifact reload that names only its file". - `liveness/position.json` `renamedFrom.note` still says other references are "named in the boot log"; still true of the boot run and outside the order's line, so left. - The ADR-0150 D7 addendum (`docs/adr/0150-…md` ~:288) is PR 2 (Tier H), opened after this merges. ## Verification All at head `2f305516` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), off `origin/main` `19cc8976`. - Build first (under `os-verify-lock`): `turbo run build --concurrency=2` over spec, the lint / objectql / client / client-react closures and plugin-security, 43/43 tasks; then the `check:i18n` closure it names, 64/64. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: 1 of 14 artifacts stale (`content/docs/references/**`), `gen:docs` ran, re-check `check:docs` green. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 840 passed (840), Tests 26865 passed, 1 todo. - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0. `vitest run src/position-renamed-holder-carry.test.ts`: 35/35.
Derived gates: 111 from dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack, 110 green, 1 NOT MEASURED - Every command run with its exit code captured before any pipe; the record is `pm-orders/spec/33301-gates-ran.txt` in the project share. - `check:i18n`: exit 3 (closure unbuilt) in the loop; after building the closure it names, exit 0 ("10 package(s), all bundles in sync"). - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3 on both runs (needs every package's `dist`): NOT MEASURED here, CI's. - `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "111 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 110 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED".
